name: Pirate game
summary: Rational pirates sequentially propose and vote on splitting 100 gold, killing proposers whose plan is rejected.
rules_text: There are N pirates ranked by seniority, with 100 coins. The most senior alive proposes a distribution giving an integer number of coins to each alive pirate. All alive pirates, including the proposer, vote yes or no. If at least half vote yes, with the proposer breaking ties, the proposal passes, coins are split as proposed, and the game ends. If fewer than half vote yes, the proposer is killed and removed, and the next most senior alive pirate proposes. This repeats until a proposal passes or one remains. Pirates prefer survival first, then more coins, then killing others if indifferent, and do not honor promises.
